summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 8: Photo-Heavy Menu / Product Gallery features. All features working correctly: Menu page view toggle (List/Grid), Gallery Grid View with 4-column layout, tags overlay, SOLD OUT badge, hover add-to-cart button, List View with hover zoom effect (scale-110), skeleton loading with shimmer animation, Product Detail lightbox with ZoomIn button, dark overlay, image counter, navigation arrows, thumbnail strip, Escape key close, Admin Image Management with drag-and-drop reordering, Primary badge, order numbers, set primary (star), delete (X), add image URL. Backend APIs /api/health and /api/menu/items working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: MenuPage.js: viewMode state correctly toggles between 'list' and 'grid'
SkeletonCard component properly renders shimmer animation for both grid and list views
Gallery grid uses 4-column layout on desktop (lg:grid-cols-4)
Gallery items show tags in top-left corner with proper styling
SOLD OUT overlay badge displays correctly on sold out items
Hover add-to-cart button appears in top-right corner with opacity transition
List view images have group-hover:scale-110 for zoom effect
All menu item images use loading='lazy' attribute for lazy loading
ProductDetailPage.js: Lightbox uses useCallback for keyboard handler (Escape/Arrow keys)
Lightbox navigation arrows cycle through images correctly
Thumbnail strip allows jumping to specific images
AdminItemForm.js: Drag-and-drop image reordering with visual feedback (border highlight)
Primary badge shows on first image, order numbers on all images
Set primary (star) button moves image to first position
Add image via URL input and Add button works correctly
Delete image via X button removes image from array
App.css: skeleton-shimmer keyframes animation defined correctly
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Using existing 10 menu items with images.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 8 photo gallery features fully tested. Apple and Facebook social login buttons remain MOCKED.
